obernants.operator: frame open needs narrator and level fitting u8; close accepts no keys. Claim requires status and either who+about+interp with no by, or a change without interp/from. time chooses exactly relation or at. know from is unquoted ^sN with N>0. reveal requires at least one revelation field after rejecting contradictions.
